title: twinery://guide
description: LLM-facing tool guide. The resource body is byte-identical to docs/GUIDE.md in the repo, which is itself generated from src/guide/registry.ts + tool zod schemas. A drift test (tests/contract/guide-drift.test.ts) enforces parity.

content_contract.description: Content-level invariants validated by guide-drift test.

enum: Lists every tool registered in src/guide/registry.ts
Lists every resource exposed by the server
For each tool, documents: purpose, input schema summary, output payload summary, clarification triggers
Shows one end-to-end example of building a branching story (mirrors quickstart.md)
Explains the clarification mechanism (elicitation vs fallback) so LLMs know what to do with clarification_needed payloads
